The corpus

All {{n_datasets}} datasets

Every dataset the run measured, with the flag each one rolled up to, the AUROC its strongest probe reached, and the largest overlap the leakage scan found between two of its splits. Sort any column; filter by any facet; open a row for the dataset's own page.

Every figure in this table was measured on that dataset's reference split — train for all but one of them. It is not a maximum taken over splits, and the dataset page names the split for each number it shows.

Whatever you filter and sort to is in this page's address, so a view of these rows is something you can send someone. What the columns mean is on the checks page; why one split is quoted is on the methods page.
